title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: MOFs with open metal sites and suitable pores can serve as hosts for lithium-containing species in solid-state electrolytes.
explanation: Anions associated with unsaturated Mg sites in a functionalized Mg(dobdc) host illustrate how framework chemistry can support lithium-ion conduction.
scope: MOF-based solid-state electrolytes for all-solid-state lithium batteries.
conditions: Open metal sites and an appropriate pore diameter are identified as host-design considerations.
caveats: Ionic conductivity alone is insufficient; electrode compatibility, electrochemical stability, temperature range, and interfacial ion transport also require evaluation.
